name: soonnick-skills
description: Skills for Claude Code by Soonnick0123. Each skill is its own plugin, so you install only the ones you need.

plugins.name: all-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in this marketplace in one plugin: show-me-html and ui-design-tokens. Install this or the single-skill plugins, not both, or each skill loads twice.

plugins.name: show-me-html
plugins.description: Turn any material into one self-contained HTML document that people understand quickly: diagrams with numbered calls, step-through stages, interactive rule demos, ASD-STE100 writing, light/dark, text size, PDF export.

plugins.name: ui-design-tokens
plugins.description: Keep generated UI consistent: 8pt spacing grid, modular type scale, font and CJK rules, button specs, motion timing, contrast, and restraint in explanatory text. Includes a read-only review mode that audits existing UI and reports each violation with a token-based fix.
